laws.rule: Since 1 December 2024 Porto charges a municipal tourist tax of EUR 3 per guest per night (about A$4.77, RBA rate of 30 October 2026), up to 7 consecutive nights. Under-13s and people travelling for medical treatment are among those exempt.
laws.heading: Município do Porto, Regulamento 1387/2024
